# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 95 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 95

**1** Jesus said: "If you have money, do not lend it at interest. Rather, give it to one from whom you will not get it back."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- Parallel to Luke 6:34-35 (lend without expecting return); Thomas is more radical — don't lend at all, just give
- **ⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ** / *toubo*: lending at interest / usury
- The saying moves past the Q prohibition on usury to a more radical instruction: give to someone who cannot repay
- This parallels Matthew 5:42 / Luke 6:30 ("give to everyone who begs from you") but focuses specifically on money
- The radical generosity: the gift without any expectation of return
